message:
## Vulnerability Digest

The 24-hour window was **2026-08-29 13:10 IST to 2026-08-30 13:10 IST** (2026-08-29 07:40 UTC to 2026-08-30 07:40 UTC). This DLL-component scan read, normalized, and deduplicated only `DLL_software_component.txt`; it did not read or combine either primary product-list source.

No newly reported or substantively updated vulnerability was verified in this window as affecting a component in the assigned DLL inventory.

**Findings**

None.

**MongoDB ecosystem sweep**

MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise), `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major maintained libraries were checked.

Six related BI Connector advisories were identified: CVE-2026-81490, CVE-2026-81517, CVE-2026-81518, CVE-2026-81520, CVE-2026-81532, and CVE-2026-81533. MongoDB's authoritative records and alert page place their initial publication on August 28, before this scan's cutoff, so they were excluded rather than reported as new. They affect BI Connector versions before 2.14.31 or BI Connector ODBC Driver versions before 1.4.10, depending on the CVE. Source: [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) and [GitHub Advisory Database MongoDB sweep](https://github.com/advisories?query=updated%3A2026-08-29..2026-08-30+mongodb).

**Closing**

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this scan window. Continue routine monitoring; the six MongoDB BI Connector advisories belong to the preceding reporting window.
